def g67_collect_measurements_acc(cells, execution_path, images):
    execution=json.loads(read(str(execution_path)))
    if execution['status']!='ALL_CELLS_FINISHED' or len(execution['cells'])!=len(cells):
        raise ValueError('Incomplete execution is retained; no dropped cells')
    rows=[]
    for cell,observed in zip(cells,execution['cells'],strict=True):
        request=json.loads(read(cell['request']));report=json.loads(read(cell['report']))
        phase=next(p for p in report['phases'] if p['phase']=='check')
        guardian=report['guardian'];role=cell['compilerRole']
        checks={
          'freshExecutionCell':observed['id']==cell['id'] and observed['passed'],
          'completed':report['status']=='PASS' and guardian['status']=='PASS' and guardian['commandExitCode']==0 and guardian['commandSignal']==0,
          'requestPinned':report['requestSha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['request'])['sha256'],
          'actualImage':str(Path(request['image']).resolve())==str(Path(images[role]).resolve()) and request['pins'].get(str(Path(images[role]).resolve()))==g56_ref_acc(images[role])['sha256'],
          'sourceNotImageHash':report['sourceSha256']==request['inputs'][str(Path(request['root']).resolve())],
          'sameInputs':request['inputs']==g66_control_requests_acc['A']['inputs'],
          'sameWork':report['moduleCount']==17 and report['sourceDeclarations']==2954 and report['stepCounts']=={'expand':263032,'check':1975761},
          'completeCheckNotEmit':report['stopAfter']=='check' and request['stopAfter']=='check',
          'noImagePatches':report['outputPatches']==0,
          'sameLimits':report['limits']=={'memoryMiB':8192,'rssMiB':8192,'pollMs':10,'timeoutMs':600000},
          'sameWorker':report['workerPolicy']=={'stackMiB':256,'oldGenerationMiB':6144,'youngGenerationMiB':128},
          'sameRuntime':report['runtime']['versions']['node']=='23.11.0' and report['runtime']['versions']['v8']=='12.9.202.28-node.14',
          'sameCpuScope':report['phaseCpuScope']=='Node process-wide CPU; includes worker/helper threads, excludes child processes'
        }
        rows.append({'id':cell['id'],'role':role,'triad':cell['triad'],'checkerCpuMs':phase['userCpuMs']+phase['systemCpuMs'],'checkerWallMs':phase['elapsedMs'],'footprintBytes':guardian['peakFootprintBytes'],'rssBytes':guardian['peakRssBytes'],'processWallMs':guardian['elapsedMs'],'pipelineWallMs':report['pipelineElapsedMs'],'phaseCpuScope':report['phaseCpuScope'],'stepCounts':report['stepCounts'],'checks':checks,'allChecksPassed':all(checks.values()),'report':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']),'request':g56_ref_acc(cell['request'])})
    return {'schemaVersion':1,'rows':rows,'allChecksPassed':all(r['allChecksPassed']for r in rows),'triads':[{r['role']:r for r in rows if r['triad']==i}for i in range(3)]}
